critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 2685 lines — modular refactor overdue (flagged since iter10).
cruise_demo_drivers still has broad `except Exception: pass` with no logging on failure (flagged in iter16, not addressed).

DevNavigator is currently shown to ALL users on ALL routes (including public /). Before real production launch, gate it behind an env flag (e.g. REACT_APP_DEV_NAV=on) or admin/superadmin role. Current comment says 'Hidden if URL has ?nav=off' but the compass is still visible on the passenger app to end users — that will confuse beta testers who aren't the owner. Recommend showing only when localStorage flag OR ?nav=on is set, defaulting off in prod.
The DevNav testid pattern `dev-nav-{path}` produces testids like `dev-nav--app` (double dash) and `dev-nav-` (empty) for path=`/`. Works but ugly; consider `dev-nav-item-{slug}`.
PremiumMap zoom buttons stack correctly on right edge but there is no keyboard accessibility (aria-label missing on the two zoom buttons — add aria-label='Zoom inn' / 'Zoom ut' for a11y).

customer-menu drawer close via menu-close relies on animation timing to hide; the query still returns the element after close due to slide-out animation. Non-issue for users but tests must wait ~600ms.

rca of the issue: Backend regression: cruise_demo_drivers accumulated heading over successive polls (`heading = last_heading + rand(-8,8)`) without modulo-normalizing, so after enough iterations values crossed 360 (test caught 376.49). Frontend map bearing rendering does its own modulo so this was silent for a while — only caught by iter16 assertion `0<=h<=360` on /api/cars/nearby response. Fix: wrap with `% 360` in the addition expression on server.py L548. Reproduced by pytest test_iter16::test_cars_nearby_returns_min_3_with_heading. After fix + backend restart: 5/5 passed in 8.45s.
